lease_release: Final owner release after revocation metadata; verified in task return
limitations: Common lease and access guards are cooperative, not an OS sandbox
External roots are not recursively inventoried at acquisition; exact file paths and created outputs are checked
Coordinator attests recovery and supplies hash-bound permitted PI evidence; restricted guard must be used by worker
Freeze hashes/gate metadata require task-specific scientific provenance/auditor verification; no independent scientific approval is inferred
Backup device mount/device isolation cannot be exercised against replacement hardware until it arrives
Preflight worktree fingerprint uses existing bounded hashes and size/mtime/mode for large files; complete Git status inventory is retained
